content.short: CardanoThings teaches IoT and Cardano integrations using ESP32 devices, APIs, MeshJS, and workshops.
content.description: CardanoThings.io provides workshops that combine ESP32 microcontrollers with Cardano, helping people learn how to build physical integrations with blockchain technology. The project covers basics such as setting up ESP32 devices with the Arduino IDE, then moves into NodeJS APIs, transactions with MeshJS, and tools such as Koios, Blockfrost, Charli3, and CardanoScan. Its purpose is education: showing builders how Cardano can interact with real-world devices and IoT experiments in practical lessons.
content.meta: CardanoThings teaches Cardano and IoT integrations using ESP32 devices, APIs, and MeshJS. Explore CardanoThings on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
